tools.name: renoir_overview
tools.description: What Renoir is, how many films, people and scores its graph holds, the kinds of connection between them, and where the data comes from.

tools.name: renoir_search
tools.description: Films, people and scores whose title, original title or other title contains the query, case-insensitive. Queries under three characters match a whole title exactly. Returns up to 25 matches with id, kind, title, year or life years, exact titles first; known_as names the other title a match was foun

tools.name: renoir_get_film
tools.description: A film's record by id: title, original title, year, runtime, genres, countries, language, synopsis where there is one, and directors.

tools.name: renoir_get_entity
tools.description: The compact record of any entity by id: a film, a person (roles, birth and death years) or a work of music (its kind and the film it scores).

tools.name: renoir_get_connections
tools.description: Every connection touching an entity, in both directions: credits, scores and influences. Each names both ends by id, carries the other end's title and year, and reads as a sentence. Up to 200 per page, crew before cast; total, more and offset page through the rest.
